_readme: Optional extra sample buttons for the Detector Playground (dashboard > Detector playground).
This file is intentionally empty in the repository: the project team fills it with its own labelled
evaluation texts (for example selected rows from the held-out detector test splits).
At most 24 entries are shown; labels are cut to 60 characters and texts to 100000 characters.
Source copy: web/public/assets/playground-samples.json (copied into the build).
Deployed copy: src/mirsad/static/assets/playground-samples.json (served at /assets/playground-samples.json, no rebuild needed).
